notes: Medium-hard: inject a real guest init into a copied initramfs that mounts the pseudo-filesystems, embeds and echoes the scenario seed, creates root plus a scenario user with EMPTY password fields (unauthenticated login), and hands the serial console to login/getty; then boot under TCG-only QEMU and drive the serial port programmatically through an actual login. Statefulness comes from driving a live console over a loopback TCP socket and leaving the emulator running as a background service; hidden scenarios vary user, token, and port so nothing may be hard-coded.
